title: Start here — v0.79 is the current NoSQLServer baseline
summary: NoSQLServer v0.79 is a mature ooRexx-native relational/federated engine despite its historical name. It preserves FILE, OBJECT, explicit JSON, native SQLite/GeoPackage and federated engines, SQL execution/planning, transactions, Database Core adaptation, optional Unicode and spatial predicates. v0.79 changes Alchemy service-object construction to Alchemy Objects v0.8 INIT:SUPER; database semantics are unchanged.
invariants: Do not restart development from the old v0.13 interoperability handoff.
The project name does not mean the current engine is a simple document store.
Rows/scalars/parser nodes remain lightweight; only long-lived service/runtime objects use AlchemyObject.
SECURE_READY is host-configured and is never implied by STANDARD adoption.
